paragraphs: R' La of Kafra. See the entry R' Hillel of Kafri.[^1]

notes.text: לא is retained as La without expansion. The two place forms are דכפרא and דכפרי, with initial ד meaning “of.” The pointer does not explain the relationship between the names; both abbreviated titles remain R'.
